description: This file defines server-side request handling for a Remix application, including handling of bot and browser requests, setting CORS headers, and server streaming responses.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, manages OPTIONS requests, and delegates to specific handlers for bots and browsers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles requests detected as from bots by streaming server-rendered HTML response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles browser requests by streaming server-rendered HTML response.
